title.es: El de cuando Fina consigue el trabajo
title.en: The One Where Fina Gets the Job

description.es: Fina le dice a Petra que Marta parece juzgarla constantemente. Marta anuncia que Fina ha conseguido el puesto de dependienta.
description.en: Fina tells Petra that Marta seems to be judging her constantly. Marta announces that Fina has gotten the shop assistant job.
